name: Easdale
method: tidetimes.org.uk Easdale vs its own Tobermory (UKHO-derived), applied to our gauge-fitted Tobermory: median time difference, least-squares height fit
note: tidetimes' Seil Sound, the Admiralty port nearest Easdale and Cuan Sound. Height = offset + scale * Tobermory: range ~40% smaller. HW ~30 min and LW ~44 min before Tobermory, scattering ~8 min. One height map for HW and LW: separate ones fitted under 0.01 m better but don't cross inside the range, so the curve would miss the turns. Kayak-grade, not for navigation.
calibrated_from: tidetimes.org.uk Easdale vs Tobermory, 2025-10-01 to 2026-11-25 (every 3 day(s), 545 events) via tools/calibrate-shift.ts
